findings.evidence: The corrected XML split RED/GREEN tasks T046-T047 are physically scheduled after the complete US4 consumer phase and after release qualifications T041-T045. T043 must compare XML split ranges and T045 runs the complete quickstart, yet neither task states an exact dependency on T047. The prose says US4 depends on T047, but the task graph still places every US4 task before it and then says T041-T049 are final gates. The parallel section further says T046 may be authored after T004 even though T046 itself says it depends on safe-XML RED/GREEN T026-T027. A phase-order or listed-parallel executor can therefore run the XML split test, consumers, or release qualification before the safe XML range owner is GREEN. This leaves prior DR-002 only partially closed despite the correct sole-owner contract.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate tasks so the safe XML projection/range-index T026-T027 is followed immediately by XML split RED/GREEN before every US4 consumer and release qualification. Renumber or relocate the XML tasks into the dependency-ordered phase structure, remove T046 from the after-T004 parallel set, and name T047 explicitly as a prerequisite for the File Code Unit planner/coordinator and every qualification that observes XML ranges, including the three-run release suite and final quickstart verification.

findings.evidence: T019 adds production candidate/filter/skip audit projection and deterministic audit fingerprints, which participate in manifest identity, replay, and SC-001 comparison, but no still-failing public-seam RED task owns that behavior. T015 tests candidate outcomes and canonical path audit, and T016 explicitly satisfies T015 before T019; T017-T018 own raw artifact hashing instead. T019 is not classified as contract-only or nonbehavioral and names only a post-implementation test run. The self-review claim that every production behavior has a preceding RED task is therefore false for canonical audit construction.
findings.correction_outcome: Add an explicit public-seam RED task for canonical audit outcomes, ordering, closed reasons, DetailFingerprint bytes, deterministic UUID, and replay-relevant mutation behavior immediately before T019, then make T019 its named GREEN owner. Alternatively keep relevant assertions deliberately RED after T016 and state precisely that T019 satisfies them. Preserve one owner for audit construction and record focused plus surrounding GREEN evidence.

summary: REVISE. Fresh read-only combined definition review covered the raw Story 12.2 record, specification/checklist, regenerated complete plan set and four contracts, regenerated 49-task graph, Constitution, AGENTS.md, Ubiquitous Language, PRD and August dated authorities, Story 12.1 contracts, prior raw definition verdict, and current source/test seams. The read-only speckit-analyze prerequisite helper again resolved specs/010-durable-scan-foundation from the branch convention, so analysis continued explicitly and non-destructively against the dispatch-pinned feature 011. Counts are 43 unique Functional Requirements, nine unique Success Criteria, and 49 sequential unique task IDs, with no unresolved placeholders. DR-001 is closed by stable Prepared Scan Context identity excluding CapturedAt and legacy ContextSnapshotId; DR-003 is closed by the exact disposable PostgreSQL 17 atomic-store suite; DR-004 is closed by the three-run full-PreScan qualification; and DR-005 is closed by nonbehavioral qualification labeling. DR-002's design and sole XML range ownership are correct, but the executable task ordering remains contradictory because XML split T046-T047 follows its US4 consumers and release qualifications and is simultaneously advertised as parallel after T004 despite depending on T027. A second High task-owned gap leaves canonical audit fingerprint production without an honest RED owner. One Low spec-owned statement is stale relative to the already-updated glossary. The approved host architecture remains intact: Vulgata, @colbymchenry/codegraph@1.5.0, Java 21, and jdt-language-server-1.61.0-202608141332 over stdio remain on Windows; PostgreSQL 17 is the only required Docker service; CodeGraphContext and all Story 12.3 Worker execution, dispatch, and Document generation remain excluded. No file, state, review artifact, task, branch, index, commit, or Git history was changed, and production implementation remains unauthorized.
